shipping.laneTitle: Choose the lane that fits the order
shipping.laneSubtitle: We do not publish a flat freight table. The quote depends on destination, carton volume, and whether you use our lane or your own China forwarder.
shipping.samplesHeading: China Post, Alibaba express, DHL / FedEx / TNT
shipping.samplesBody: Trial orders usually ship as a China Post small packet, Alibaba online express, or an international courier. We confirm the lane after you share destination and urgency.
shipping.bulkHeading: FCL, LCL, or your China forwarder
shipping.bulkBody: Production lots typically go FCL or LCL by sea. You may appoint your own China freight forwarder for air, rail, or sea. The factory can deliver to the warehouse or port they name.
shipping.stepsSubtitle: Three steps from inquiry to a packing-list estimate. No online checkout freight — we quote the lane with your order.
shipping.returnText: Report factory quality defects within {{days}} days of arrival, with photos and order details. We arrange replacement or credit after inspection. Return freight is quoted case by case.
returnBullets: Factory defects raised within {{days}} days of arrival
Photos and order details required for inspection
Replacement or credit after we confirm the issue
Custom OEM, printed, or made-to-order goods are not returnable for a change of mind
shipping.quoteText: Send destination, quantity, and your preferred lane. The wholesale team replies with available options.
shipping.trackLead: Paste the number we send after the sample or production lot leaves Yiwu. China Post, DHL, FedEx, and TNT open on the carrier site. We do not store the number.
trackBullets: Sea freight uses a bill of lading or your China forwarder portal, not this box
If the lane is unclear, choose Auto detect (17TRACK)
